descriptions.en: Creates miniature gravitational singularities that can be used for scientific study or self-defense.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SIMULOR）能制造出微型的重力奇异点，可用于科学研究或自我防卫。

descriptions.en: Torid lobs a toxic payload.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TORID）托里德能抛射出剧毒榴弹。

descriptions.en: Ignis produces a stream of intense heat.
descriptions.zh: （英文：IGNIS）伊格尼斯能产生一股强烈的热浪。

descriptions.en: A blood-red variant of this destructive flamethrower.
descriptions.zh: （英文：IGNIS WRAITH）这款破坏性火焰喷射器的血红变体。

descriptions.en: Ogris fires detonite-infused casings.
descriptions.zh: （英文：OGRIS）食人女魔能发射满载易爆物的炮弹。

descriptions.en: The SUPRA is a heavy laser gun with a short wind up time.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SUPRA）苏普拉是把重型激光枪，可在很短的时间内启动。

descriptions.en: Laser Rifle with Corpus safe-guards removed.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FLUX RIFLE）一把已卸除了 Corpus 安全装置的激光步枪。

descriptions.en: A customized version of the Dera, featuring a metallic finish and Lotus decal.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DERA VANDAL）这把是定制化版本的德拉步枪，拥有着金属质感及 Lotus 的徽记。

descriptions.en: The Dera is a repeater that fires super-heated plasma.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DERA）德拉是一把射出高热电浆的连发步枪。

descriptions.en: The Lanka fires a high velocity projectile through magnetic induction.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LANKA）兰卡使用电磁加速射出高速子弹。

descriptions.en: Custom variant of a Corpus classic. Staggering blasts now ricochet and have greater range at the cost of a slower fire and reload speed. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET ARCA PLASMOR）Corpus 经典武器的特制变体。惊人的爆炸会反弹且拥有更高的射程，但代价是更低的射速和装填速度。幸存下来的敌人会被辐射耗尽生命。

descriptions.en: The expert engineers in Parvos Granum’s division have optimized the Ferrox’s lethal power.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET FERROX）帕尔沃斯·格拉努部门的专业工程师优化了铁晶磁轨炮的杀伤力。

descriptions.en: Sister-modified Flux Rifle with increased fire rate and range. Recharge has been replaced with ammo clips to accommodate greater power needs.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET FLUX RIFLE）由姐妹们改装过的通量步枪提升了射速和射程。充电系统已被弹匣取代以适应更高的电量消耗。

descriptions.en: Advances in microelectronics have improved a Corpus classic. Tenet Glaxion’s photon beam strikes up to four enemies at once. It also boasts superior Damage, Critical Chance, and Status Chance.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET GLAXION）微电子技术的进步改进了 Corpus 的经典武器。信条·冷冻光束步枪的光子束最多可以同时攻击四个敌人。它还拥有较高的伤害、暴击几率和触发几率。

descriptions.en: Once a mining tool adapted for military purposes, Parvosian engineering has enhanced the Quanta's lethality even further.
descriptions.zh: （英文：Tenet Quanta）曾经的采矿工具为了军事用途而改造，帕尔沃斯式的工程技术进一步增强了量子切割器的杀伤力。

descriptions.en: Parvosian upgrade of the classic Tetra. Slower fire rate but with a larger magazine. Can now alt-fire entire clip as a large burst radius grenade launcher.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET TETRA）经典特拉的帕尔沃斯式升级版。射速较慢但拥有更大的弹匣。次要射击可以将整个弹匣作为高爆炸范围的榴弹发射出去。

descriptions.en:
Bolts from this Corpus bow deliver a one-two punch of an icy pulse, followed by a conventional explosion. Excess ammo picked up for other weapons will be converted into charges for the Lenz. 

Warning: Safety-protocols do not exist on this prototype.
descriptions.zh:
（英文：LENZ）从这把 Corpus 弓箭中射出的箭矢将会放出极寒脉冲，紧接产生常规爆炸。额外拾取的其他武器弹药将会转化为楞次弓的电荷。

警告：此原型机未使用安全协议。

descriptions.en: The explosive potential of the Lenz, enhanced with Prisma crystals.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PRISMA LENZ）通过棱晶强化，楞次弓的爆炸潜力得以发掘。

descriptions.en: The Amprex rifle fires a continuous beam of high voltage electricity that arcs among nearby enemies. This weapon excels at Crowd Control.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AMPREX）安培克斯步枪可持续发射致命电光束并在敌人中形成电弧。这件武器在群体控制方面很优秀。

descriptions.en: Drawing from its huge quad-chambered magazine, the Tetra is capable of unleashing a sustained barrage of lethal energy bolts.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TETRA）借由它巨大的四腔弹匣，特拉能持续发射由能量弹形成的致命弹幕。

descriptions.en: When bathed in Void energy and prisma crystal, the simple Tetra becomes a beacon of style and intimidation.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PRISMA TETRA）在浸泡过虚空能量与棱晶后，这把单纯的特拉能量步枪成为了威吓与风格的指标。

descriptions.en: Bring negotiations to an instant conclusion with this Corpus assault rifle. Switch effortlessly between charged explosive shots and rapid-fire electrical assault mode.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AMBASSADOR）使用这支 Corpus 突击步枪让谈判立即结束。可以在充能爆炸狙击和速射电子突击模式之间自由切换。

descriptions.en: Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.
descriptions.zh: （英文：OPTICOR ）一旦这挺 Corpus 激光炮充能完毕，便能释放出毁灭性的光能爆炸。

names.zh: 奥堤克光子枪 变体

descriptions.en: Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.
descriptions.zh: （英文：OPTICOR ）一旦这挺 Corpus 激光炮充能完毕，便能释放出毁灭性的光能爆炸。

descriptions.en: With a precision crafted lens, this customized Opticor achieves a level of performance previously thought impossible.
descriptions.zh: （英文：OPTICOR VANDAL）装有精密制作的透镜，这把定制化版本的奥堤克光子枪达到了以前认为不可能有的性能水平。

descriptions.en: This discreet rocket launcher is equally at home in a board meeting or on a casual outing. Aimed rockets are wire-guided for greater accuracy, but travel more slowly. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the weapon when holstered.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENET ENVOY）这款朴素的火箭发射器在董事会会议或休闲郊游时同样适用。瞄准发射的火箭是线导的，精确度更高，但飞行速度更慢。配备了获得专利批准的格拉努公文包系统，收起时自动装填。

descriptions.en: Fires a photon beam that halts molecular vibrations, causing instant and painful freezing.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GLAXION）发射出一道能暂停分子振动的光子束，造成痛苦的瞬间冻结。

descriptions.en: A cutting-edge, halogen-cooled electron accelerator capable of snap-freezing a target in moments.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GLAXION VANDAL）一把用尖端技术打造的卤素冷却电子加速器，能够瞬间将目标冷冻起来。

descriptions.en: Nail them to the wall! The Stahlta automatic rifle propels hardened steel rods at high speed, while a charged fire mode fuses a number of volatile rods together for a large radioactive explosion.
descriptions.zh: （英文：STAHLTA）将敌人钉在墙上！这件钢刃自动步枪把硬化钢棒推进到高速状态，而蓄力射击模式会将大量不稳定的钢棒融合在一起，产生巨大的放射性爆炸。

descriptions.en: Corpus ingenuity leveraging Tau-tech to create a high-capacity bi-modal sniper weapon of terrifying capability. Zoom in to reduce recoil and add punch through. Zoom again to fire a bursting viral round, but with a lower rate of fire. Komorex features built-in ammo conversion.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KOMOREX）Corpus 独具匠心地利用 Tau 技术创造了一把可怕的大弹匣容量狙击枪。变焦可减少后坐力并增加穿透力。再次变焦可发射爆炸的病毒子弹，但射速降低。猛毒有自带的弹药转换。

descriptions.en: A weapon that builds charge the more it kills. Hit capacity then release for an obliterating discharge of power.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BATTACOR）一把借由击杀敌人来充能的武器。蓄满后可以释放出毁灭性的力量。

descriptions.en: Feel the kick of this Corpus shotgun as it shatters a high-yield crystal into anyone and anything standing in your way.
descriptions.zh: （英文：EXERGIS）当这把 Corpus 霰弹枪将高产水晶轰入阻挡在你前方的任何人或物时，请细细品味其后坐力。

descriptions.en: This weapon was designed to assist with the excavation of mineral deposits from large asteroids, but has been adapted for military purposes.
descriptions.zh: （英文：QUANTA）这个武器原本是设计用来在大型小行星上协助挖掘矿物，但现在已更改为应用于军事用途上。

descriptions.en: A customized version of the Quanta, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.
descriptions.zh: （英文：QUANTA VANDAL）这把是定制化版本的量子切割器，拥有着金属质感及 Lotus 的徽记。

descriptions.en: Stagger targets with blasts from this Corpus engineered plasma shotgun. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ARCA PLASMOR）用这把 Corpus 设计的等离子霰弹枪来击倒你的目标。幸存下来的敌人会被辐射耗尽生命。

descriptions.en: When its twin-lasers converge on a target a circuit is created, frying the subject.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CONVECTRIX）当双道激光汇聚在目标上时，便会产生回路，将敌人给炸熟。

descriptions.en: Enveloped in deep red composite enamel, this Penta variant features a higher fire-rate and over-sized magazine.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CARMINE PENTA）由深红色复合珐琅包络的潘塔变体，具有更高的射速和超大容量的弹匣。

descriptions.en: The Penta Launcher fires up to five grenades that can be remotely triggered at just the right moment.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PENTA）潘塔发射器最多可发射五发榴弹，并在最适当的时候进行远距离引爆。

descriptions.en: A customized version of the powerful Supra, featuring a metallic finish and Lotus decal.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SUPRA VANDAL）强力苏普拉的定制版本，拥有着金属质感及 Lotus 的徽记。

descriptions.en: Discharge a rail of ionized death or throw the Ferrox like a spear and create a localized field of attraction no enemy can escape from.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FERROX）释放一道电离的死光，或掷出铁晶磁轨炮以产生一个敌人无法逃脱的局部吸引力场。

descriptions.en: This Grineer bow delivers vengeance in the form of clusterbomb-tipped arrows that can be detonated mid-air or on impact. Low quiver capacity, arrows are recovered singly.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA BRAMMA）这把 Grineer 弓箭能射出尖端配有集束炸弹的复仇箭矢，可以在空中或遇到冲击时引爆。低箭袋容量，箭矢逐个恢复。

descriptions.en: The Kuva Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room that do not slow down. Larger Magazine Capacity and Reload Speed. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA DRAKGOON）这款改造版龙骑兵破片炮可击发出会四处弹射且不会减速的高热弹片。它拥有更大的弹匣容量和更快的装填速度。能以散射或压缩集中的方式进行射击。

descriptions.en: Forged at the behest of the Worm Queen herself, this already powerful shotgun now has the additional ability to fire from all four barrels simultaneously.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA HEK）蠕虫女皇亲自下令锻造这把本就十分强大的霰弹枪，拥有额外功能可以同时从全部四个枪管开火。

descriptions.en: This powerful Grineer burst rifle has been retrofitted to add semi-automatic and automatic fire modes.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA HIND）这款强大的 Grineer 连射步枪经过改装，增加了半自动和全自动开火模式。

descriptions.en: The custom weapon of a fearsome Kuva Lich. It has greater reload speed, lower recoil and greater accuracy than the standard-issue Karak rifle.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA KARAK）某位可怕的赤毒玄骸所使用的改装武器。相比于原版卡拉克步枪，它拥有更快的装填速度、更低的后座力以及更高的精准度。

descriptions.en: The Kuva Kohm variant has a higher fire rate than the original. For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kuva Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA KOHM ）这把赤毒寇恩热能枪变体拥有比原版更高的射速。赤毒寇恩热能枪在每一次高速连续的射击时都会额外击发出一发能量弹，使其更具杀伤力。

descriptions.en: The custom weapon of a fearsome Kuva Lich. Unlike the basic version the Kuva Ogris fires detonite-infused casings semi-automatically, from a smaller magazine, while dealing greater damage per shot.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA OGRIS）某位可怕的赤毒玄骸所使用的改装武器。与原版不同，它拥有更小的弹匣，能以半自动的方式发射满载易爆物的炮弹，同时每一发能造成更多伤害。

descriptions.en: Unlike a standard Quartakk this Kuva Lich variant fires automatically from the hip while retaining its signature feature when aimed: annihilating targets with four simultaneous shots.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA QUARTAKK）与原版夸塔克不同，这种赤毒玄骸夸塔克变体能从腰际全自动开火射击，同时保持了瞄准时的特点：用 4 发同步射击来消灭目标。

descriptions.en: The Kuva Sobek's exceptional Reload Speed, Critical Chance, and Status Chance make it a natural fit for the Kuva Lich's dominant spirit.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA SOBEK）赤毒·鳄神出色的装填速度、暴击几率和触发几率，与赤毒玄骸的霸道风格高度契合。

descriptions.en: This Lich-variant grenade launcher hurls mayhem and destruction with an increased Reload Speed.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA TONKOR）这种榴弹发射器玄骸变体拥有更快的装填速度，可以对敌人猛烈射出暴乱与破坏。

descriptions.en: An even stronger Zarr cannon to meet the demands of Kuva Liches. With stronger explosive barrages, and long-range flak shots.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA ZARR）一把更强大的沙皇火炮，满足了赤毒玄骸的需求。拥有更强的爆裂弹幕和更远距离的高射炮弹。

descriptions.en: A powerful mid-range rifle used by Grineer shock troops, the Hind fires in five round bursts.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HIND）由 Grineer 突击部队使用的强力中阶步枪，雌鹿一次射击就是五连发。

descriptions.en: Equipped with a huge Magazine and impressive Fire Rate, the Grakata is the preferred weapon of Grineer Lancers.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GRAKATA）装备了巨大弹匣，拥有非凡的射速。葛拉卡达是 Grineer 枪兵的首选。

descriptions.en: The Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DRAKGOON）龙骑兵破片炮可击发出会四处弹射的高热弹片。能以散射或压缩集中的方式进行射击。

descriptions.en: With pinpoint accuracy, the Grinlok lever-action repeating rifle can easily find the soft spot on any target.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GRINLOK）凭借极高的精确度，葛恩火枪这把杠杆作用连发步枪可以轻而易举地找到任何目标的弱点。

descriptions.en: Prisma-crystal enhancement creates here a prestige instrument; a weapon capable of taking life at astonishing range with but a single pull of its exquisitely-tooled trigger.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PRISMA GRINLOK）棱晶的强化铸造了一个名贵的器械；一把能够在意想不到的范围内夺走生命的武器，并且只需要扣一次其精确好使的扳机。

descriptions.en: Solid, dependable and deadly. The Karak is a standard issue rifle in many Grineer platoons.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KARAK）结实、可靠又致命。卡拉克是很多Grineer小队的一把标准配置步枪。

descriptions.en: A different take on the Grineer assault rifle, the Karak Wraith features unique styling.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KARAK WRAITH）有别于 Grineer 制式的突击步枪，卡拉克·亡魂有着独一无二的风格。

descriptions.en: The Miter launches high velocity saw blades, tearing apart anyone unfortunate enough to be in their path.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MITER）米特尔发射高速锯片，撕裂任何不幸在其路径上的人。

descriptions.en: Built by the Grineer for their elite troopers, the Vulkar is a devastating distance weapon. In the right hands it is capable of taking down targets long before they get into attack range.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VULKAR）Grineer 为其精锐部队制造，金工火神是一把毁灭性的远程兵器。在正确的使用者手中它能在目标进入攻击距离之前将其迅速放倒。

descriptions.en: A blood-red variant of this devastating sniper rifle.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VULKAR WRAITH）一把有着血红色装饰且杀伤力极大的狙击步枪。

descriptions.en: Unload a barrage of explosives or a huge shot of flak from this cannon’s enormous barrel.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ZARR）从这具火炮的巨型炮管可以倾泻出爆裂的弹幕或者一枚大型的高射炮弹。

descriptions.en: Equipped with a huge Magazine and impressive Fire Rate, the Grakata is the preferred weapon of Grineer Lancers.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GRAKATA）装备了巨大弹匣，拥有非凡的射速。葛拉卡达是 Grineer 枪兵的首选。

descriptions.en: Launch super-heated slugs at individual foes, or hurl the entire weapon and ignite groups of enemies in a flash inferno.
descriptions.zh: （英文：JAVLOK）对单个敌人发射极热的子弹。或者将整个武器掷出并在地狱火光中点燃成群的敌人。

descriptions.en: Annihilate targets with four simultaneous shots from this high-caliber Grineer rifle.
descriptions.zh: （英文：QUARTAKK）用这把大口径的 Grineer 步枪的 4 发同步射击来消灭目标。

descriptions.en: Mark your targets and unleash a barrage of bullets, the Buzlok's homing rounds always find the enemy. Marked targets are more likely to take critical hits.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BUZLOK）标记目标，并射出密集的弹幕，巴兹火枪的制导子弹永远能够找到敌人。被标记的敌人更容易遭到暴击。

descriptions.en: Hurl mayhem and destruction with this Grineer grenade launcher.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TONKOR）以这把 Grineer 榴弹发射器对敌人猛烈射出暴乱与破坏。

descriptions.en: Spike enemies to the wall or reel them in with this burst harpoon gun.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HARPAK）以这把爆裂鱼叉枪卷起敌人，或将他们钉在墙上。

descriptions.en: Detonate heads with this slow-firing rifle that rewards precision.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KUVA CHAKKHURR）用这款需要精确瞄准的低射速步枪来打爆敌人的头颅。

descriptions.en: Long before clone-rot set in, elite Grineer Commanders protected the surviving Orokin from rebelling Warframes with these formidable rifles. When Gotva Prime inflicts a Status Effect, its next shot has a chance to be a Super Critical hit.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GOTVA PRIME）早在克隆基因衰变之前，精英 Grineer 指挥官就用这把强大的步枪从战甲的叛乱中保护幸存的奥罗金人。当骨葬 Prime 造成异常状态时，下一次射击有机会造成超级暴击。

descriptions.en: For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KOHM ）寇恩热能枪在每一次高速连续的射击时都会额外击发出一发能量弹，使其更具杀伤力。

descriptions.en: Pick off targets by highlighting distant enemies using this Grineer rifle's advanced laser sighting system. Deadly in both single fire and automatic modes.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ARGONAK）利用这把 Grineer 步枪的先进激光瞄准系统高亮敌人，将他们逐一射杀。单发和全自动模式都非常致命。

descriptions.en: Adorned with void hardened prisma crystal, this Gorgon variant is prized for its beauty and enhanced mechanics.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PRISMA GORGON）装饰了虚空的硬化棱晶，使这把蛇发女妖因她的美丽与增强的机能变得更具价值。

descriptions.en: The Gorgon Wraith is a powerful variant of its precursor that features unique styling.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GORGON WRAITH）蛇发女妖·亡魂是其前身的强大变体，以它独特的风格为特色。

descriptions.en: Overcome with Infestation, this bow's arrows now spread poisonous contagion to any surface they hit.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MUTALIST CERNOS）受到感染者的侵蚀后，这把弓的箭矢能够在击中的任何表面散播病毒。

descriptions.en: Amplify shockwaves of devastating sound with this Technocyte virus infested shotgun that hungers for blood, and desires nothing more than to feed upon its enemies. Alternative fire at enemies not vulnerable to Mercy Kills to swarm them with infested mites, while firing at vulnerable ones will perform a ranged execution.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CODA BASSOCYST）通过这把渴求饮血食肉的科技细胞病毒感染霰弹枪来放大毁灭性声音的冲击波。次要射击无法被怜悯之击攻击的敌人，用感染螨虫将他们包围，而射击能被怜悯之击攻击的敌人则可远程处决。

descriptions.en: With increased magazine size, the Coda Bubonico was born of the Technocyte virus' need to spread infection. Primary Fire rate ramps up with continuous fire.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CODA BUBONICO）终幕·横痃重炮增加了弹匣容量，其设计源于科技细胞病毒对传播感染的渴望。持续射击时，主要射击的射速会逐渐提升。

descriptions.en: The Technocyte virus did nothing but increase the Hema’s thirst for blood. With increased Fire Rate, Magazine Size, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Status Chance, and Damage.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CODA HEMA）科技细胞病毒没有起到什么作用，只是增加了血肢的嗜血性。具有更高的射速、弹匣容量、暴击几率、暴击伤害、触发几率和伤害。

descriptions.en: Delivers a virus-laden barb to its victim that continues to damage it before exploding. With increased Damage, Reload Speed, Magazine Size, Status Chance, and explosion radius.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CODA SPOROTHRIX）向受害者投掷一个携带病毒的倒钩，持续造成伤害直至爆炸。具有更高的伤害、装填速度、弹匣容量、触发几率和爆炸半径。

descriptions.en: Firing a nonstop stream of vile corrosive gastric juice, the Coda Synapse comes with increased Magazine size, Beam Length, Status Chance, Punch Through, and Damage.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CODA SYNAPSE）终幕·突触生化枪可以持续发射恶臭腐蚀性胃液。具有更高的弹匣容量、光束长度、触发几率、穿透和伤害。

descriptions.en: Rain down a triple volley of explosive disease bladders from a distance, then move in for the kill by unloading a multi-shot barrage of toxic barbs with primary fire.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BUBONICO）可远距离投下三连爆炸性病毒囊腔，随后可通过主要射击一次性释放出多重毒螫来消灭敌人。

descriptions.en: A bizarre union of Corpus technology and Infested biology, this automatic rifle can also deploy an irradiated airborne infested mass. Further field testing is required to fully understand the potential of this weapon.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MUTALIST QUANTA）这是一个 Corpus 科技与感染生物的奇特组合，这把自动步枪也能发射出一种带有辐射性的可通过空气传播的感染物质。为了全面了解这把武器的潜在能力，还需要更多的实地测试。

descriptions.en: This long-distance rifle fires a razor-sharp, virus-soaked barb that continues to attack its host before violently erupting in a spore-laden mist. Scoped headshots increase lethality.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SPOROTHRIX）这把长射程步枪发射锋利且浸透病毒的倒钩，在猛烈爆发出充满孢子的雾气前，它会继续攻击其宿主。开镜爆头可增加杀伤力。

descriptions.en: A bloodsucker. This symbiotic burst-rifle leeches health to forge its ammo and then restores health with each headshot.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HEMA）一把吸血者。这把点放式的共生步枪会吸取生命来铸造弹药，并在每次爆头射击时恢复生命。

descriptions.en: Powered by a bio-chemical reaction, the Infested Synapse rifle fries its targets with a steady stream of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive energy.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SYNAPSE）由生化反应驱动，被感染的突触生化枪通过一束稳定的<DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀能量炙烤目标。

descriptions.en: Completely overwhelmed by Infested biology, this former Quanta now fires organic ordnance and a harpoon like appendage.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PARACYST）被感染生物体完全包覆，这种形态的量子切割器会射出类似器质性的附肢尖叉。

descriptions.en: Fires seven beams of continuous biochemical energy which depletes the life of any surface they contact.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PHAGE）射出七道持续性的生化能量，侵蚀任何物质的表面，使其寿命枯竭。

descriptions.en: This pre-Orokin weapon earned its popularity for its reliability in tough conditions. When hip-firing, its Ammo Efficiency increases. When aiming, headshots have a high Critical Chance.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AX-52）这款前奥罗金时代的武器因其在恶劣条件下的可靠性而广受欢迎。腰射时，弹药效率会提高。瞄准时，爆头有极高的暴击几率。

descriptions.en: Perforate Techrot, and anyone else who stands in your way, with this Scaldra machine gun. Alternative fire pummels targets with Efervon laced buckshot.
descriptions.zh: （英文：EFV-5 JUPITER）使用这把炽蛇军机枪扫射科腐者和任何胆敢阻挡你的人。次要射击使用涂有艾弗旺的霰弹重击目标。

descriptions.en: Put them down so that they stay down, with this Scaldra slug launcher.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PURGATOR 1）用这把炽蛇军武器让敌人再起不能。

descriptions.en: The MK1-Paris is the standard issue bow for all Tenno.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MK1-PARIS）MK1-帕里斯是给Tenno的标准配置弓箭。

descriptions.en: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.
descriptions.zh: （英文：STRUN）斯特朗是一把标准的霰弹枪，可靠，灵活，致命。

descriptions.en: Deliver a ruthless barrage of Sentient artillery from this instrument of death. Alt-fire splits the weapon apart into separate rifles, expanding its devastation by tracking up to 4 targets at once, while consuming more ammo per shot.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HAALVU）通过这件死亡利器释放无情的 Sentient 炮火。次要射击可将武器拆分为多把独立的步枪，同时锁定最多 4 个目标，进一步扩展其毁灭威力，但每发射击将消耗更多弹药。

descriptions.en: This Sentient war instrument can either barrage targets with explosive bolts or draw on its regenerative battery to create twin plasma beams that chain through targets. When fully drained, Health is leeched from nearby foes for a short period.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BASMU）这种 Sentient 军械可以用爆炸投射物密集轰击目标，也可以利用其可再生电池制造出两股将多个目标束缚在一起的等离子光束。当电量完全耗尽时，会在短时间内吸取附近敌人的生命值。

descriptions.en: This arm-cannon, ripped from a Sentient, rapid-fires thermal pulses that explode in an electrical blast. Features an ammo-less quick charge capacitor, that emits a knock-back pulse and strips Sentient damage resistances when fully discharged.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SHEDU）这种从 Sentient 身上扯下来的手炮能快速射出热脉冲，并在电击中爆炸。它有一个不需要弹药的快充电容器，在完全放电时会发出回弹脉冲并解除 Sentient 的伤害抗性。

descriptions.en: A custom weapon made from many possible parts. Assembled by Rude Zuud in Fortuna and Father in the Necralisk.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KITGUN）一件由多个可供搭配的部件组成的武器。由福尔图娜的粗鲁的祖德和殁世幽都的"父亲"组装。

descriptions.en: A custom weapon made from many possible parts. Assembled by Rude Zuud in Fortuna and Father in the Necralisk.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KITGUN）一件由多个可供搭配的部件组成的武器。由福尔图娜的粗鲁的祖德和殁世幽都的"父亲"组装。

descriptions.en: A custom weapon made from many possible parts. Assembled by Rude Zuud in Fortuna and Father in the Necralisk.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KITGUN）一件由多个可供搭配的部件组成的武器。由福尔图娜的粗鲁的祖德和殁世幽都的"父亲"组装。

descriptions.en: A custom weapon made from many possible parts. Assembled by Rude Zuud in Fortuna and Father in the Necralisk.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KITGUN）一件由多个可供搭配的部件组成的武器。由福尔图娜的粗鲁的祖德和殁世幽都的"父亲"组装。

descriptions.en: A custom weapon made from many possible parts. Assembled by Rude Zuud in Fortuna and Father in the Necralisk.
descriptions.zh: （英文：KITGUN）一件由多个可供搭配的部件组成的武器。由福尔图娜的粗鲁的祖德和殁世幽都的"父亲"组装。

descriptions.en: Bring down judgement, with this boltor crafted by the Arbiters of Hexis.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TELOS BOLTOR）用这把均衡仲裁者锻造的螺钉步枪降下审判。

descriptions.en: Cephalon Suda's custom issue Simulor was built to satisfy her curiosity.
descriptions.zh: 中枢苏达的自定义改造重力奇点拟成枪，仅只是为了满足她的好奇心所打造。

descriptions.en: Echo nature's violent beauty with this special Tigris.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SANCTI TIGRIS）这把特制猛虎呼应了大自然的暴戾之美。

descriptions.en: Ruthless and efficient, just like the free-market.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SECURA PENTA）如同自由市场一般，重效率，不讲情面。

descriptions.en: A finely tuned instrument of assassination.
descriptions.zh: （英文：RAKTA CERNOS）一把精巧的刺杀工具。

descriptions.en: Forged in the fires of rebel struggle, this shotgun is a force for liberation.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VAYKOR HEK）在反抗拼搏的烈焰中铸造，造就这把成为自由解放之力的散弹枪。

descriptions.en: Bring hell to the battlefield with Uriel's signature rifle and bayonet combination. Occupying both primary and melee slots, this unique weapon blends precision marksmanship with unrelenting melee combat.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VINQUIBUS）通过 Uriel 的标志性步枪和刺刀组合，将地狱之火带入战场。这把独特的武器既可作为主要武器也可作为近战武器，完美融合了精准的射击和毫不留情的近战攻击。

descriptions.en: Evoking the design of ancient bows, the high impact Cernos is perfect for hunting down highly shielded enemies.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CERNOS）这把冲击力强大的西诺斯长弓十分擅长猎杀高护盾的敌人，让人回想起古代长弓的设计。

descriptions.en: Daikyu takes great strength to draw back, but provides added power and range to every shot.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DAIKYU）大久和弓需要相当程度的施力才能开弓，但每次射击同时也提供了更强的威力与更远的射程。

descriptions.en: The versatile Cinta can fire arrows in quick succession, quickly charge a shock wave, or fully charge a powerful focused shot.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CINTA）遂心的功能非常多样化，可以快速连续地射出箭矢，迅速充能释放冲击震波，或完全充能并进行威力强大的聚焦式射击。
（英文：NUNCHASA）Narin 的标志性弓箭是北风的冰霜使者。次要开火模式会释放一支充能暴雪箭，冻结接触到的敌人并留下一道寒冰的痕迹。

descriptions.en: Based on one of the world's oldest weapon designs, this Tenno-crafted weapon can be used both in stealth and in open combat. The Paris uses a chargeable magnetic field to launch arrows capable of impaling enemies to walls.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PARIS）以世界最古老的武器设计为基础，Tenno 所制作的武器不论隐匿行动和交火接战均可使用。帕里斯可利用磁场蓄力，其射出的箭矢足以将敌人钉在墙上。

descriptions.en: Hunhow’s gift, carved from the bones of his kin. Shots can be charged and held; release them just before full charge for maximum effect.
descriptions.zh: （英文：NATARUK）Hunhow 的礼物，由其亲属的骨头雕刻而成。射击时可以充能并维持该状态；在完全充能前一刻发射即可获得最佳效果。

descriptions.en: A noble bow to hunt hellish beasts.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CERNOS PRIME）一把用来狩猎恶兽的高贵之弓。

descriptions.en: Long believed lost, the mighty Daikyu Prime was the pride of many a Tenno dojo. Designed to strike the foe where they are weakest, its powerful shots repay careful marksmanship.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DAIKYU PRIME）长久以来，人们一直认为强大的大久和弓 Prime 早已失传，它是许多 Tenno 道场的骄傲。它旨在直击敌人的弱点，其强大的射击威力与精湛的射击技术相得益彰。

descriptions.en: Each arrow spawns a swarm of sticky appendages on impact. These tongue-like probes latch onto nearby unfortunates and drag them close before bursting into a mess of diseased goo.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PROBOSCIS CERNOS）每支箭在冲击时都会产生大量的粘稠附着物。这些像舌头一样的探针会吸附在附近的倒霉蛋身上，并把他们拖近，然后爆裂形成一团病害黏液。

descriptions.en: Discovered deep inside an ancient Orokin derelict, the Paris Prime increases the kinetic energy of any bolt it fires, dealing more damage than its more common counterpart.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PARIS PRIME）从遗弃的古老奥罗金船只的深处中发现的帕里斯 Prime，比原版提升了更多箭矢的动能，能造成更多的伤害。

descriptions.en: Dread is the calling card of The Stalker. It fires arrows that can decapitate.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DREAD）恐惧是追猎者的标志性武器，其射出的箭矢足以取人首级。

descriptions.en:
Counter the dread of battle with a song of praise. Enemies cannot hurt your allies while wounded by Evensong's arrows. Kills with Evensong empower ally weapons with Multishot.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.
descriptions.zh:
（英文：EVENSONG）用赞美之歌来对抗战斗中的恐惧。被晚祷之箭所伤的敌人将无法伤害你的友军。使用晚祷击杀敌人将增强友军的武器的多重射击。

当晚祷、歌颂与和谐一同奏响时，体验 Jade 之合奏真正的力量。

descriptions.en: Based on one of the world's oldest weapon designs, this Tenno-crafted weapon can be used both in stealth and in open combat. The Paris uses a chargeable magnetic field to launch arrows capable of impaling enemies to walls.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PARIS）以世界最古老的武器设计为基础，Tenno 所制作的武器不论隐匿行动和交火接战均可使用。帕里斯可利用磁场蓄力，其射出的箭矢足以将敌人钉在墙上。

descriptions.en: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the third anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DEX SYBARIS）这是 Lotus 为第一位从低温催眠中醒来的 Tenno 所准备的一份 3 周年纪念礼物。

descriptions.en: The double-barreled Tigris shotgun fires two bursts in rapid succession, easily taking down the toughest prey.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TIGRIS）猛虎双管霰弹枪能快速连续的双弹齐发，轻松地拿下棘手的猎物。

descriptions.en: Forged by a master gunsmith, this Tenno burst rifle will strike down targets with swift precision.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TIBERON）由大师级枪械制造工匠打造的这把 Tenno 三连发步枪可以迅速精确地击倒目标。

descriptions.en: Scope out the enemy with this long-range revolver style rifle.
descriptions.zh: （英文：RUBICO）以这把长距离转轮式步枪彻底探清敌人。

descriptions.en: Slash targets with a single precise bolt from Garuda's signature crossbow. Alt-fire to let loose a barrage of bolts. All bolts have a chance to cause <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status, and Headshots have a chance to increase Reload Speed. When wielded by Garuda Nagantaka gains a slight Punch Through.
descriptions.zh: （英文：NAGANTAKA）Garuda 的标志性十字弓能以一支精准的弩矢斩断目标，而次要射击则能发射出弩矢弹幕；每支弩矢都有可能造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态，爆头射击则可加快装填速度。在被 Garuda 使用时，噬蛇弩会获得少量的穿透效果。

descriptions.en: Depend on Higasa when it rains bullets. Aiming creates a shield that blocks weapon fire. Kills and blocked shots charge a beam released by Alternate Fire.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HIGASA）依靠晴日伞抵御如雨倾泻的子弹。瞄准可形成一面盾牌，阻挡敌方武器的射击。击杀和阻挡射击将为次要射击充能，以释放光束。

descriptions.en: Gyre's signature weapon has two fire modes. Primary fire shocks enemies with electrical orbs. Alternate fire is a large ball of electricity that sticks to any surface and pulses <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity before it explodes. In Gyre's hands, the weapon has a small amount of multishot.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ALTERNOX）Gyre 的标志性武器有两种射击模式。主要射击可通过带电球体攻击敌人。次要射击可产生一个大型带电球体，该球体可附着在任何表面并在爆炸之前产生 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>带电脉冲。被 Gyre 使用时，该武器可产生少量的多重射击。

descriptions.en: Deploy the radar disc to reveal hidden enemies and then strike with precision shots that punch through all obstacles in the way.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ZENITH）部署雷达盘揭示隐藏的敌人，紧接着用足以穿透障碍的精确射击打击敌人。

descriptions.en: Firing high-velocity blades, this weapon can also be used as a battle-saw, shredding anything unfortunate enough to get within range.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PANTHERA）发射高速刀刃，这把武器同时也能作为战斗用电锯，切碎任何进入攻击范围的倒霉鬼。

descriptions.en: Kullervo's signature weapon boasts melee synergy. Every shot that lands increases the wielder's Melee Combo count. When Kullervo wields Rauta, it also increases his Melee Combo duration.
descriptions.zh: （英文：RAUTA）Kullervo 的标志性武器具有近战协同的优势。每次命中都会增加持枪者的近战连击数。当 Kullervo 使用锐铁时，它也会增加他的近战连击持续时间。

descriptions.en: Engage your enemies with deadly speed. This weapon reloads even faster when its wielder sprints, faster still with Gauss.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ACCELTRA PRIME）以致命的速度与敌人交战。当使用者冲刺时，会有更快的装填速度，搭配 Gauss 使用时，速度还会更快。

descriptions.en: The gilded speargun of Styanax Prime shines like a beacon across the battlefield, invigorating allies and stunning enemies.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AFENTIS PRIME）Styanax Prime 的镀金标枪如同战场上的灯塔般闪耀，鼓舞盟友，震慑敌人。

descriptions.en: Orokin gold enhances the conductivity of Gyre Prime's signature rifle, enabling it to fire massive electrifying orbs.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ALTERNOX PRIME）奥罗金黄金增强了 Gyre Prime 标志性步枪的导电性，使其能够发射巨大的带电球体。

descriptions.en: Loose explosive glass slugs that tear through enemies with Gara’s signature shotgun, presented here in its spectacular Prime form.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ASTILLA PRIME）Gara 标志性的霰弹枪以惊人的 Prime 形态呈现，可以射出爆炸性的玻璃弹头来击穿敌人。

descriptions.en: This rapid-fire classic is the Orokin-engineered definition of silent, pinpoint lethality.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BAZA PRIME）这把经典的高射速冲锋枪体现了奥罗金工艺对于无声和精确杀伤的定义。

descriptions.en: Fires Orokin designed bolts that are faster and sharper.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BOLTOR PRIME）射出由奥罗金设计、更快更尖锐的螺钉。

descriptions.en: Once thought lost to the ages, attempts to reengineer the Burston Prime never fully replicated this weapon's power and agility.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BURSTON PRIME）一度以为随着岁月流逝而失去踪迹，尝试研发伯斯顿 Prime 但从没能够复制出往日的威力以及操控性。

descriptions.en: A golden shotgun, forged for those who deliver judgment.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CEDO PRIME）一把金色的霰弹枪，为那些执裁者而打造。

descriptions.en: Heavy in the hand with a bone-crunching kickback. This Prime version of this shotgun adds remote detonation of the weapon's airburst round.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CORINTH PRIME）份量不轻且具有相当的后坐力。这种霰弹枪的 Prime 版本可以将武器射出的空爆弹远程引爆。

descriptions.en: Wield a storm. Fulmin Prime's electric rounds switch between lightning beams and short-range bursts. Wisp quickly swaps between each mode with her elemental prowess.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FULMIN PRIME）唤起风暴。雷霆 Prime 的电击弹可在闪电光束和短距离点射之间切换。Wisp 凭借她的元素之力获得更快的模式切换速度。

descriptions.en: Caliban Prime's signature sniper rifle is no mere ceremonial weapon. A sign, perhaps, that peace between Orokin and Sentient was destined to be fleeting. Struck enemies become lightning rods, with a chance to attract bolts of chain lightning that can jump to nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VADARYA PRIME）Caliban Prime 的标志性狙击步枪并非仅仅是仪式武器。它或许预示着奥罗金与 Sentient 之间的和平注定转瞬即逝。被击中的敌人会变成避雷针，有几率吸引连锁闪电，这些闪电会跳跃到附近的敌人身上。

descriptions.en: A golden version of Garuda's versatile crossbow, as fashioned by the Orokin's finest weaponsmiths. Alt-fire to let loose a barrage of bolts. All bolts have a chance to cause <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status, and Headshot kills have a chance to increase Reload Speed. When wielded by Garuda the Nagantaka gains a slight Punch Through.
descriptions.zh: （英文：NAGANTAKA PRIME）Garuda 的标志性十字弓的镀金版本，由奥罗金最优秀的工匠所锻造。次要射击能发射出弩矢弹幕；每支弩矢都有可能造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态，爆头击杀则可加快装填速度。在被 Garuda 使用时，噬蛇弩会获得少量的穿透效果。

descriptions.en: The max-velocity saw-launcher perfected. Features a larger magazine, faster fire rate, and a radial, slashing ricochet.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PANTHERA PRIME）完美打造的极速锯片发射器。具有更大的弹匣、更快的射速，以及可在一定范围内弹跳的锋利锯片。

descriptions.en: The one who exalted Voruna to her Prime form imbued her signature sniper rifle with increased magazine size and ammo capacity, as if to arm her for a long hunt.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PERIGAL PRIME）将 Voruna 提升到 Prime 状态的人，也提升了她的标志性狙击步枪，增加了弹匣容量和弹药容量，仿佛是要让她做好长时间狩猎的准备。

descriptions.en: Phantasma Prime is burnished with deadly force. In Revenant’s hands, it has increased magazine capacity. The might of its irradiated plasma is reminiscent of the fearsome Eidolon.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PHANTASMA PRIME）幻离子 Prime 由死亡之力打磨而成。它在 Revenant 的手中，会拥有更多的弹匣容量。它的等离子照射光束所发出的威力，会让人不禁想起那令人生畏的夜灵。

descriptions.en: Smite the unrighteous with Harrow Prime's signature speargun.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SCOURGE PRIME）用 Harrow Prime 的标志性标枪打击不义之徒。

descriptions.en: Known for taking down whole squads with its single massive magazine, few weapons were as feared as the Prime Soma.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SOMA PRIME）以威猛的火力成功掠倒整支队伍而闻名，仅有少数武器能像月神 Prime 一样令人闻之丧胆。
（英文：STEFLOS PRIME）带有镀金棘刺的玫瑰。通过这把 Citrine Prime 的标志性霰弹枪，从更远的地方施展致命一击。

descriptions.en: Between measured staccato and staggering crescendo, Stradavar Prime never fails to call down a devastating finale.
descriptions.zh: （英文：STRADAVAR PRIME）可在整齐的断奏和摇摆的渐强音之间自由切换，让斯特拉迪瓦 Prime 绝不错失任何一个给予毁灭终章的机会。

descriptions.en: A classic shotgun design, embellished for the elite as only the Orokin could.
descriptions.zh: （英文：STRUN PRIME）只有奥罗金能为精英们打造出如此经典的霰弹枪设计。

descriptions.en: Sleek and slender, a golden symbol of Tenno perfection.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SYBARIS PRIME）纤细而又熠熠生辉，象征着 Tenno 的至善至美。

descriptions.en: Add lethal staccato percussion to Octavia's melodies with this masterpiece assault rifle.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENORA PRIME）通过这件突击步枪大师之作来为 Octavia 的旋律添加致命的顿挫击打。

descriptions.en: Art meets ingenuity with this beautifully deadly rifle.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TIBERON PRIME）在这柄美丽而又致命的步枪里，艺术与精巧的设计不期而遇。

descriptions.en: An artifact of exquisite beauty. A weapon of deadly purpose.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TIGRIS PRIME）既是精美的工艺品，也是致命的武器。

descriptions.en: Sleek lines and golden accents define this masterpiece of the illustrious Entrati family.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TRUMNA PRIME）流畅的线条和金色的点缀定义了这件来自著名的英择谛家族的杰作。

descriptions.en: Once thought destroyed, the newly uncovered Vectis Prime revives Tenno martial traditions.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VECTIS PRIME）曾经一度认为已被消灭殆尽；这把新发现的守望者 Prime 还原了 Tenno 的武之传统。

descriptions.en: Tenno artistry. Ancient craft. A weapon of surgical precision and devastating effect. Each bolt fired by Zhuge Prime explodes shortly after embedding.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ZHUGE PRIME）Tenno 技艺。古老工艺。一把极为精确且富有破坏力的武器。诸葛连弩 Prime 的每支箭会在击中嵌入的瞬间爆炸。

descriptions.en: This devastating automatic crossbow is the perfect marriage of ancient Earth weaponry and Tenno technology.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ZHUGE）这把毁灭性的自动连弩是古代地球军武与 Tenno 工艺完美结合的杰作。

descriptions.en: Irradiate enemies with a continuous stream of deadly plasma. Charging secondary fire releases a glob of plasma that erupts with homing bomblets on impact. Increased Magazine Capacity when wielded by Revenant.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PHANTASMA）用连续的致命等离子束照射敌人；次要攻击充能后可以释放出一团等离子球，球体碰撞时会产生多发制导的小型炸弹。在被 Revenant 使用时，该武器的弹匣容量会提升。

descriptions.en: For the hunter, the apex of the sniper's art. For the hunted, a gateway to the next life.
descriptions.zh: （英文：RUBICO PRIME）对猎人而言，这是狙击艺术的巅峰。对于猎物而言，这是通向来生的大门。

descriptions.en: Using a barrage of rapid-fire plasma rockets, Gauss’ signature weapon lays down a path of destruction. Reloads are faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. For safety, rockets arm after traveling a safe distance.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ACCELTRA）通过使用速射电浆火箭弹，Gauss 的标志性武器铺设了一条毁灭之路。冲刺时可以更快地装填弹匣，在 Gauss 手里效果更加显著。为了安全起见，火箭会在离开安全距离后爆炸。

descriptions.en: A high-capacity, high-damage enforcer, this weapon can switch between the high crit semi-automatic and full automatic firing modes.
descriptions.zh: （英文：STRADAVAR）一把兼具大容量弹匣和高伤害的杀器，这把武器可以在半自动和全自动开火模式间切换。

descriptions.en: Launch a glaive that ricochets off surfaces in bursts of elemental damage, then perforate enemies with primary fire’s precision buck-shot. Damage increases with each Status Effect afflicting a target. Lavos will transmute a small portion of any ammo pickup to Primary Ammo when wielding his signature Cedo.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CEDO）发射能在表面弹跳并爆发出元素伤害的战刃，然后通过主要射击的精准鹿弹来击穿敌人。伤害会随着目标所受到的每个异常状态而增加。当 Lavos 持有他标志性的塞多时，他会将一小部分拾取到的任意弹药转化为主要武器弹药。

descriptions.en: Unload percussive machine gun fire, or strike a heavy chord with a single charge shot. When Octavia wields her signature rifle alt-fire Headshot Kills have a chance to instantly refill the magazine.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TENORA）释放出强大冲击力的机枪炮火，或者用单发充能射击进行重和弦攻击。当 Octavia 使用她的标志性步枪时，由次要射击所造成的爆头击杀有几率立即装填弹匣。

descriptions.en: Cyte-09's signature rifle is an ideal match for forceful gunners. A precisely timed reload increases reload speed and infuses the new magazine with Heat Damage.
descriptions.zh: （英文：RECONIFEX）Cyte-09 的标志性步枪是强力枪手的理想搭档。精确的装填可提高装填速度，并为下一个弹匣注入火焰伤害。

descriptions.en: Blast enemies with glass slugs that devastate on impact. In Gara's hands, this signature weapon has a larger Ammo Pool.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ASTILLA）用玻璃弹头轰炸敌人，碰撞时将炸裂。当 Gara 手持这把的标志性武器时，其弹药上限会得到提升。

descriptions.en: Deliver a massive punch with each blast of this shotgun, or launch a round that explodes mid-air knocking down nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CORINTH）用这把霰弹枪打出沉重的一击，或者射出一发在空中爆炸的子弹来击倒附近的敌人。

descriptions.en: Styanax’s speargun matches his might. Throw Afentis to pin an enemy and nearby enemies will also be stunned. Throw Afentis onto the ground to buff nearby allies with Ballistarii Might. The buff increases reload speed, fire rate, and ammo pools and reduces recoil. Allies who kill enemies with Ballistarii Might maintain the buff temporarily when they move away from Afentis.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AFENTIS）Styanax 的标枪与他的力量相匹配。投掷圣英来压制敌人，其附近的敌人也会被击晕。将圣英投掷到地上，可创造一个为友军带来增益的炮兵威能力场，可增加装填速度，射速，弹药最大值，并降低后坐力。当获得炮兵威能的友军击杀敌人后，炮兵威能效果则会在他们离开圣英力场后继续维持一小段时间。

descriptions.en: Turn the enemy's worst nightmare into reality with Follie's signature rifle. The Enkaus will instantly kill and dissolve inked enemies that are damaged at low health. Shooting inked enemies siphons ink back into the Enkaus, allowing for a constant flow of creative destruction.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ENKAUS）使用 Follie 的标志性步枪将敌人的噩梦化为现实。当被墨汁侵染的敌人生命值较低时，绘墨会瞬间将其击杀并溶解。射击被墨汁侵染的敌人可将墨水回流至绘墨，实现持续不断的创造性破坏。

descriptions.en: A sturdy burst-rifle of considerable age and unknown origin collected by Teshin during his many years wandering the Origin System.
descriptions.zh: （英文：THORNBAK）这是 Teshin 在始源星系流浪多年期间收集的一把坚固的点射步枪，年代久远且来历不明。

descriptions.en: Blast targets with corrosive plasma projectiles, or toss the scepter to inflict an energy field upon nearby enemies that amplifies their brain waves to attract bullets.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SCOURGE）用腐蚀性的等离子体轰炸目标，或是投出手杖用能量场增幅附近敌人的脑波，使其吸引子弹。

descriptions.en: Like a breath of wind, shots fired by this multi-barrel sniper are felt but never seen by its targets. Headshots in quick succession increase the Perigale's ammo efficiency. When the Perigale is wielded by Voruna, its ammo pool increases.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PERIGALE）就像一阵风，这把多管狙击枪发射的子弹能被它的目标感觉到，却从未被看到。快速连续爆头可提高月面狂风的弹药效率。当 Voruna 手持月面狂风时，它的弹药库会因此增加。

descriptions.en: The Quellor was standard-issue to Dax Railjack crews of the Old War, dating back to the earliest, pre-Sigma craft. A rapid-fire assault rifle with a hefty magazine-size, the Quellor is an all-round workhorse. Also capable of large, short-range cryo-blasts.
descriptions.zh: （英文：QUELLOR）压制者是远古之战时禁卫航道星舰舰员的标准配置武器，其最早的铸造可追溯到西格玛系列之前。这是一种速射突击步枪，拥有较大的弹匣容量，是全能型的主战武器。而且也有着巨大的、短距离的冰冻冲击。

descriptions.en: Precise calibration, rapid trigger-pull and a steady hand all combine to bring down the hardiest prey on two legs or four.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VELDT）结合精确校准、快速击发式扳机以及稳定持枪三项特点，打倒各种顽强的猎物。

descriptions.en: This unusual automatic rifle feels strangely familiar and has two fire modes. Primary fire packs radiation damage. Alternate fire charges up to launch an explosive projectile.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AEOLAK）这把非同寻常的自动步枪给人一种奇异的熟悉感，并且拥有两种开火模式。主要射击附带辐射伤害，次要射击充能后可发射一枚爆炸投射物。

descriptions.en: Make easy prey of enemies with this quiet, agile, and pinpoint accurate Tenno submachine gun.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BAZA）凭借着安静、灵敏及精准的特性，这把 Tenno 冲锋枪能轻易地猎杀敌人。

descriptions.en: Strike with silent lightning or the pummeling drum of thunder. Alternate between stealthy short-range electrical discharge, and automatic lightning gun. Faster mode-switch when used by Wisp.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FULMIN）用寂静或雷鸣般的闪电来攻击。可在隐秘的短距离放电和自动闪电枪两种模式中切换。在被 Wisp 使用时，武器的模式切换速度会更快。

descriptions.en: This Tenno crafted, lever action rifle, is equal parts elegance and executioner.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SYBARIS）这支 Tenno 定制的扳杆式步枪是优雅的刽子手。

descriptions.en: An energy projectile bursts forth from the Steflos and grows as it rushes toward enemies. The projectile's duration increases when it hits an enemy. When Citrine fires the Steflos, its projectile speed increases.
descriptions.zh: （英文：STEFLOS）石晶之花发射的能量弹会在飞向敌人时变大。当投射物击中敌人时，其飞行持续时间会增加。当 Citrine 使用石晶之花时，它的投射物速度会增加。

descriptions.en: Quickly fire off a volley of deadly bolts with the Attica repeating crossbow.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ATTICA）阿提卡连弩能够快速发射一片致命的弩矢弹幕。

descriptions.en: The Latron Wraith is a powerful variation of the standard, semi-automatic rifle that features unique styling.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LATRON WRAITH）拉特昂·亡魂是把变异版本的半自动步枪，拥有强大火力以及自己的独特外观。

descriptions.en: The Boltor fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BOLTOR）螺钉步枪所发射出的的慢速重型螺钉足以将敌人钉在墙上。

descriptions.en: A classic Orokin weapon, Braton Prime features modified damage levels and a larger magazine over the standard model.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BRATON PRIME）一把经典的  奥罗金兵器，布莱顿 Prime 比起标准版，强化了伤害能力以及更大的弹匣。

descriptions.en: The Burston fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of automatic rifles and the accuracy of semi-automatic rifles.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BURSTON）伯斯顿是三发点射步枪，在机枪的杀伤力和半自动的准确度之间取得平衡。

descriptions.en: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.
descriptions.zh: （英文：GORGON）蛇发女妖是一把重机枪。巨大的弹匣使它能够提供压制火力并长时间维持高伤害率。

descriptions.en: The ornamental Latron Prime exploits ancient Orokin technology to get a slight damage increase over the standard Latron.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LATRON PRIME）这把经过装饰的拉特昂 Prime 利用了远古的奥罗金技术，拥有比标准版拉特昂还高的伤害。

descriptions.en: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BRATON）布莱顿是一支自动步枪。高射速和高精度使其成为了 Tenno 的最爱。

descriptions.en: The Latron is a highly efficient rifle that performs well at medium and at long range, its accuracy making it a deadly weapon in the hands of skilled marksmen.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LATRON）拉特昂是一支半自动步枪。其高性能和高准确性令它在一名能精准射击的人手中时可以变得十分致命。

descriptions.en: Manufactured by the Corpus, the Snipetron is a powerful and accurate rifle that sports optical zoom capabilities. Perfect for long range engagements.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SNIPETRON）由 Corpus 加工，狙击特昂是一把具备变焦能力的强力精准步枪。适合远距离战斗。

descriptions.en: The MK1-Braton is the standard issue rifle for all Tenno. A versatile weapon that can be customized to support a wide variety of play styles.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MK1-BRATON）MK1-布莱顿是 Tenno 的标准配置步枪，是一把可被定制化以支援各种使用风格的多功能武器。

descriptions.en: Accuracy coupled with a massive magazine makes the Soma assault rifle a formidable weapon.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SOMA）高准度与高容量弹匣的结合，使月神突击步枪成为强大的武器。

descriptions.en: A classic Tenno sniper rifle, the Vectis is ideal for ranged takedowns.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VECTIS）守望者是把适于远距击杀敌人的理想武器，一把 Tenno 的经典狙击步枪。

descriptions.en: A special version of the standard Braton rifle with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher accuracy and damage values. The Braton Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BRATON VANDAL）布莱顿的特别版本，有着较低的射速，但更高的精准度和伤害。布莱顿·破坏者被 Tenno 定制成蓝绿色金属光泽，并在握把上绘制了 Lotus 纹样。

descriptions.en: A customized version of the elusive Snipetron, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SNIPETRON VANDAL）这把狙击特昂是少见的定制化版本，拥有金属质感及莲花徽记。

descriptions.en: Sobek is a rapid-firing Grineer shotgun that has reduced damage per shot but boasts extra large magazine capacity.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SOBEK）鳄神是一把速射型 Grineer 霰弹枪，虽降低每一枪的伤害，但拥有超大弹匣容量。

descriptions.en: A shotgun with low accuracy and strong recoil, but able to deliver its payload in full-auto. The Boar is best used at close range.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BOAR）野猪有着较低的精度和大后坐力，但可以全自动发射载弹。最适宜近距离使用。

descriptions.en: One of the finest examples of Tenno craftsmanship, the Boar Prime offers a higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and a much higher per-shot damage.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BOAR PRIME）Tenno 工艺设计的绝佳案例之一，野猪 Prime 能提供更快的射速、更大的弹匣容量，以及更高的子弹伤害。

descriptions.en: The Hek is a powerful shotgun that fires its shots with a tight spread, making it efficient at medium range as long as its strong recoil is properly managed.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HEK）海克是一把能发射密集弹丸的强力霰弹枪，只要能驾驭其猛烈后坐力，在中距离战斗也能有效发挥。

descriptions.en: The Hek is a powerful shotgun that fires its shots with a tight spread, making it efficient at medium range as long as its strong recoil is properly managed.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HEK）海克是一把能发射密集弹丸的强力霰弹枪，只要能驾驭其猛烈后坐力，在中距离战斗也能有效发挥。

descriptions.en: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.
descriptions.zh: （英文：STRUN）斯特朗是一把标准的霰弹枪，可靠，灵活，致命。

descriptions.en: A different take on a familiar shotgun, the Strun Wraith features unique styling.
descriptions.zh: （英文：STRUN WRAITH）熟知霰弹枪截然不同的造型，斯特朗·亡魂拥有着相当特殊的风格。

descriptions.en: The Felarx invokes ancient times when aristocrats hunted game. For ceremonies, Orokin elites bred creatures reminiscent of game birds to reanimate cultural myths. They gave the Zariman crew Felarx and a brace of birds as a sign of acceptance into elite society. The brace of birds becomes a pair of pistols at the hands of the Void.
descriptions.zh: （英文：FELARX）逐枭唤起了古代贵族狩猎活动的历史。为了仪式，奥罗金精英培育出与其狩猎的猛禽相像之生物来重现文化传说。他们赐予「扎里曼号」船员逐枭和一对猛禽，作为接受船员们进入精英社会的标志。而这对猛禽在虚空的作用下变成了一对手枪。

descriptions.en: Zariman colonists originally intended to use the Phenmor in burial rites. In Orokin society, the higher the rank, the greater number of volleys for the deceased. Its stock is carved from Phenaureus Pine, a tree designed to release seedlings only onto scorched earth. In the hands of the Void, the Phenmor becomes darkly aggressive.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PHENMOR）扎里曼殖民者们最初是希望在葬礼上使用凤殁的。在奥罗金的社会体系中，越高阶级的逝者葬礼上，人们为了纪念逝者射出的子弹数量就越多。这把武器的枪托由只在焦土上释放幼苗的樟子松雕刻而成。在与虚空的接触中，凤殁充满了阴暗的侵略性。

descriptions.en: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. A heavy, oversized automatic rifle with withering fire that delivers rapid heat damage. Secondary fire unleashes an arcing projectile that ricochets off surfaces and enemies, exploding on every impact.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TRUMNA）一把由英择谛所设计的古老武器。主要射击可从目标身上吸取生命精华，以助燃次要射击带来的毁灭性攻击。这把具有毁灭级火力的重型超大号自动步枪可迅速造成火焰伤害。次要射击可呈弧线抛射出一枚跳射弹丸，每次撞击到物体表面和敌人都会造成爆炸伤害。

descriptions.en: Encased in plates refined from pure prisma crystals, this rare element gives this assault rifle a radiant luster.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PRISMA GRAKATA）这把突击步枪镀上了一层纯净的棱晶，此种稀有元素赋予它闪耀动人的光泽。
